decision.reason: The real cohort is adequate to validate prospective cohort construction and leakage controls, but a defensible clustered/repeated-measures prediction-model sample-size justification has not established adequate independent outcome information for flexible model development, calibration, and model-family selection. The 1,250 rows must not be treated as 1,250 independent participants.
requiredBeforeModelFitting: Freeze the exact candidate predictor and model-family plan before performance evaluation.
Provide a sample-size/information justification appropriate to the repeated participant-level design rather than a blanket events-per-variable rule.
Address the severe site outcome imbalance and pre-specify how site transport will be evaluated.
Pre-specify handling of the 41.36% missing wellness measurements without looking at predictive performance.
Keep camera incremental value as a separate paired same-cohort question; SoccerMon cannot validate the webcam features because it contains no Movement Science Lab camera measurements.

methodologicalContext.note: Modern prediction-model sample-size methods require context-specific assumptions about predictor parameters, outcome prevalence, anticipated predictive signal, and acceptable optimism/calibration precision. This audit deliberately does not replace that calculation with a universal 10-events-per-predictor rule.
references: Riley RD et al. Statistics in Medicine 2019; PMID 30357870; DOI 10.1002/sim.7992.
